notes.title: 🐧🍀 Alpha Update is here!

This time we’ve prepared new tools, deeper pet systems, new building options, smoother gameplay, and plenty of balance updates to make your journey even more fun.[/p][p][b]Keyboard binding[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Full keyboard control customization — set up your own keybinds.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Xbox controller support[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Full Xbox controller compatibility (PlayStation DualSense support coming later!)[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Interaction changes[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Improved “hold” interactions for better usability and responsiveness.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Tutorial text updates[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Clearer and more helpful guidance for new players.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Pet system[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Taming: the ability to tame wild pets.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Personality system: each pet has unique traits you’ll need to learn.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Trust system: pets won’t run away if they trust you, but low trust may cause them to leave.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Mood system: low mood can make pets ignore commands; higher mood will be needed for future features like expeditions.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Behaviors & commands: basic actions (more coming later!)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Curiosity system: pets will explore and react to their surroundings.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Feeding: feeding pets impacts their trust[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][b]New tool: Pickaxe[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Unlockable after completing the alpha (building the totem). Used for gathering basic resources.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][b]New building/housing options[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]More construction options — expand your settlement with new building options.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Buildings now only need to be unlocked once.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Trading with the caveman[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]A simple trading system: buy items from Ube using Knowledge; sell resources through the Contribution Box.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Inventory & chest improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Better inventory management and smoother chest system functionality.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Movement improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]More fluid and responsive character movement.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Visual updates (level art)[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Adjustments and polish to the world’s visuals.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Game balance[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Reduced CO₂ consumption at night; notes.title: Prehistoric survival game Astrobotanica secures Kickstarter funding in one week
notes.content:
Could you survive in prehistoric times? What if you weren't a human, but a stranded alien attempting to make their way on our planet? While Ark asks how you'd manage among the dinosaurs, new survival game Astrobotanica takes a different angle. As Xel, a highly intelligent but out-of-luck extraterrestrial who finds themselves stuck on Pleistocene-era Earth, you'll have to learn about the world around you and deal with the locals if you're ever going to make it home. In just one week since developer Space Goblin launched a Kickstarter, it's already flown past its initial funding goal.

notes.title: Promising prehistoric survival game Astrobotanica reveals Kickstarter plans
notes.content:
Ark has you looking over your shoulder for devious dinosaurs. The Forest throws cannibalistic mutants at you. In Subnautica, it's sea monsters and the constant threat of running out of oxygen. On the whole, survival games love to stress you out. It's part of the charm. But here's an upcoming survival title that prides itself on "positivity and relaxation" while still looking like a really engrossing experience. It's called Astrobotanica, a botany and exploration-focused survival experience, and its developer just revealed plans for a Kickstarter campaign to help realize its potential.

notes.title: Survival game Astrobotanica is a reverse Subnautica, outlines big plans for 2025
notes.content:
If you're looking for a survival game with a slightly different flavor than most, Astrobotanica is for you. While Subnautica takes you to the ocean floor, Valheim transports you to a world of Norse mythology, and Palworld makes you a creature tamer, Astrobotanica takes place on a prehistoric version of Earth. Between a demo, Kickstarter, and Steam Early Access launch, there's a lot to get excited about - Astrobotanica has big plans for 2025.

notes.title: How we plan to develop ASTROBOTANICA
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome, Alien Adventurers![/h1]
Today we are excited to share the next key stages in development for [b]ASTROBOTANICA[/b], our upcoming botany-centric survival game that has been generating significant buzz since the official game reveal back in August. Here are the key milestones for the coming months:
[list]
[*][b]Kickstarter Campaign[/b] to speed up and expand development
[*][b]Closed Alpha Testing[/b] to allow hands-on access to the game for kickstarter backers
[*][b]Public Demo Release[/b] to showcase our progress and open to feedback from broad audience
[/list]
[i]New screenshots from the game’s engine are also presented to our Steam followers at the end of this update.[/i] 

We invite everyone to [b]wishlist [/b]and [b]follow [/b]ASTROBOTANICA on Steam and connect with us on social media for the latest updates. This will ensure that announcements and updates will appear in your library, so be sure to do this if you want to not miss anything!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2720920/ASTROBOTANICA

[h2]Kickstarter Campaign Coming Soon[/h2]
We are glad to announce that just in a couple of months we will be launching a [b]Kickstarter campaign[/b]. With your support, we hope to accelerate the game's development and to enhance the initial design to make the game bigger, longer and even more engaging. Stay tuned for details such as pledges, goals, and reward tiers, and of course, unique features available only via Kickstarter.

[h2]Alpha Testing for Backers[/h2]
As one of several initiatives to engage our community in the development of the game, we’re planning to invite [b]Kickstarter backers[/b] to play a closed Alpha build via Steam. This holds true to the studio’s promise to work on ASTROBOTANICA transparently and act on community feedback. We hope you’re as excited to play the game long before anyone else, as we are to invite players this early into the development cycle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173174/1ce6cf09358b0f86ffbae77b7b4d62b3022cee6b.jpg[/img]

[h2]Public Demo[/h2]
Following the Alpha testing, we plan to implement all feedback, and go ahead with a release of public Demo via Steam in the second half of the year. This will provide an excellent opportunity to showcase the results of the community collaboration. By inviting more players to immerse in the vibrant world of [b]ASTROBOTANICA[/b], we hope to test every aspect of the game, and to generate new ideas and suggestions for the next milestone - Early Access release. Details will be announced once we make progress and plans crystallize. Thus, follow us to not miss any important details.

[h2]Let’s Brainstorm Together[/h2]
We warmly invite you to join our [b]Discord community[/b] right now, and participate in discussions, see new screenshots first, exchange thoughts and ideas, discuss your favorite games, and spend good time in good company. 
Feel free to also visit our [b]Steam forum[/b], where we’re available and eager to talk and connect with other players.

[h3]Join here:[/h3]
[url=https://discord.gg/G4QVyFYsMK][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173174/60a1fd99c92f1ce40d20a9ba3c10dc7042bcba57.png[/img]
[/url]
[b]Discord:[/b] https://discord.gg/G4QVyFYsMK

[b]Steam Forum:[/b] https://steamcommunity.com/app/2720920/discussions/

[h2]ASTROBOTANICA Gameplay[/h2]
Set 300,000 years ago during Earth’s Pleistocene era, [b]ASTROBOTANICA [/b]invites players into a lush open-world environment full of primal flora and fauna. As an alien botanist named [b]Xel[/b], you will navigate survival challenges and engage in:
[olist]
[*] [b]Cultivation:[/b] Nurturing plant species and learning how to manage farming in Earth's environtments.
[*] [b]Plant research:[/b] Experimenting with fruit to discover their unique qualities and effects on living organisms and the environment.
[*] [b]Exploration:[/b] Discovering new plants in diverse biomes, learning to tackle dangerous wildlife and solve hidden mysteries.
[*] [b]Tonics Crafting:[/b] Mixing ingredients obtained from local plant life to manufacture mixtures for various uses, and developing recipes for later.
[*] [b]Human Interaction:[/b] Breaking the ice and connecting with primal humans inhabiting the islands, to foster relationships that can lead to trading or mutual assistance.
[/olist]
There’s much more to ASTROBOTANICA, which you will have the opportunity to experience firsthand very soon.

[previewyoutube=bs4qZ1vtldw;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Future Development Plans[/h2]
Among other ideas, we are planning on implementing co-op features for [b]ASTROBOTANICA [/b]at some point between the early access release and 1.0 launch. This multiplayer experience will allow players to collaborate by sharing resources, taking roles, changing shifts in game’s errands, and embark on adventures and exploration together. We are actively working on these features, thus, we invite you to participate in discussions on our socials and help shape the future of [b]ASTROBOTANICA[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173174/ec3dc816c2a2cc8dd51b5472da873fd1578aafb8.png[/img]

notes.title: This upcoming survival game promises an unusual twist: You're an alien botanist who's crash-landed on Earth 300,000 years ago
notes.content: In most survival games, you're cast naked and alone in a fantastical world with nothing but a rock and a stick to help you stay alive. The upcoming Astrobotanica promises to be a little different: Instead of playing as a human trying desperately to survive in an alien environment, you're an alien facing the same challenge on Earth in the very distant past... Read more.

notes.title: New survival game Astrobotanica feels like Subnautica on land
notes.content:
It's safe to say that Subnautica has very much earned its place as one of my favorite videogames of all time. Despite the dangers that lurk in the dark, floating around the vast oceans of a weird, wonderful aquatic world never gets old. But Subnautica 2 is far, far away if Unknown Worlds' most recent comments are anything to go by, so I've found myself craving something new but equally as chill. Enter Astrobotanica, a brand-new survival game from a team of industry veterans.

Read the rest of the story...
